primary_endpoint: Improvement in liver histological findings from baseline after 48 weeks of treatment.
efficacy_outcome: At 48 weeks, improvement with actual maintenance treatment occurred in 38.7%, 63.8%, and 55.8% with survodutide 2.4, 4.8, and 6.0 mg, respectively, versus 15.2% with placebo; reported logistic-regression p-values were 0.0010, <0.0001, and <0.0001, respectively.
safety_signal: Serious AEs occurred in 5/93, 7/69, and 5/52 participants on survodutide 2.4, 4.8, and 6.0 mg, respectively, versus 5/79 on placebo; no deaths were reported.
